texto: «Hallo» is the usual greeting in any daily situation, while «hoi» is more informal between friends and young people. «Dag» serves both to greet («Good morning / hello») and to say goodbye («Bye.»). To introduce you use «ik heet...» (my name is...) or «ik ben...» (I am...). To ask the name is «Hoe heet jij?» (What's your name?). When you say goodbye you say «tot ziens» (so far) or «doei» (chao, informal).

frases.en: I'm Anna. How do you do?
Nice to meet you. See you later!

bloques.pregunta: How is «Hello.» said in Dutch in a standard and neutral manner?

opciones.explicacion: It's the usual and neutral greeting.
It's an informal farewell («Bye.»).
It means «See you later.».
«Hoi» is informal hello and «Hoe heet jij?» asks the name.

opciones.texto: Bye, Anna. Where are you from?
opciones.explicacion: Mix a farewell with a question of origin.

opciones.texto: Hey, Anna. How are you today?
opciones.explicacion: He asks what he's like, not what his name is.
With the jij pronoun, the «heet» form is used.
It means «I am» («ik ben»), it doesn't fit «Hoe».
It means «Thank you.», it's not a verb to call.

bloques.pregunta: What does Anna express with these words?

opciones.texto: I'm Anna. How do you do?
opciones.explicacion: «Ik ben» expresses identity and «Aangenaam» is the courtesy formula when you meet.

opciones.texto: I'm leaving now. See you later!
opciones.explicacion: He doesn't say goodbye.

opciones.texto: Hey, everybody. Thank you very much!
opciones.explicacion: It's not a plural greeting of thanks.

bloques.explicacion: Look at the order: subject (Ik) and verb (heet).

bloques.pregunta: To say goodbye informally to a Dutch friend, what word do you use?

opciones.explicacion: It is the daily colloquial farewell («chao»).
It's a greeting («Hello.»), not a farewell.
It means «Nice to meet you.».
It is a colloquial farewell equivalent to «chao» or «Bye.».
It's an entrance greeting.
It's a courtesy request.

bloques.pregunta: Choose the correct translation of this farewell.

opciones.texto: Nice to meet you. See you later!
opciones.explicacion: «Aangenaam» is enchanted and «tot ziens» is so far.
Mix thanks and request.
It contains formulas of welcome of arrival.

intro: We begin with the basic formulas of greeting and presentation in Dutch.
